The landmine and viking presses aren't in the app, so I used the closest presses I have.","title":"Shoulders","days":[{"name":"Shoulders","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-overhead-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze glutes, press straight up past your face.\n\n"},{"key":"single-arm-dumbbell-overhead-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Press slightly forward, like a landmine arc."},{"key":"machine-shoulder-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Neutral handles, drive up smoothly."},{"key":"dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with elbows, stop at shoulder height."},{"key":"reverse-pec-deck","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Sweep wide, pause at the back."}]}],"unmet":["There's no landmine press in the app, so I used a single-arm dumbbell overhead press.","There's no viking press in the app, so I used a machine shoulder press with neutral handles."]}
